    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">mirror-switcher（镜像切换工具 / Mirror Switcher）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>

<h1><a id="mirror-switcher%EF%BC%88%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F%E5%88%87%E6%8D%A2%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7-mirror-switcher%EF%BC%89" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>mirror-switcher（镜像切换工具 / Mirror Switcher）</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>全平台环境镜像源 / 版本切换工具集 — 命令格式 <strong>1:1 复刻 nrm</strong>，统一 <code>switch-</code> 前缀，覆盖前端、后端、Python、容器、Linux 系统、运维常用包管理器源。</p>
<p><em>A unified mirror-source / version switcher across 20+ ecosystems — nrm-style CLI, <code>switch-</code> prefix, cross-platform pure-Python (stdlib only).</em></p>
</blockquote>
<p>如果你熟悉 <code>nrm</code>，那么本套件中的 <strong>20 个工具</strong>你都会用——它们共享同一套命令，仅业务对象不同。每个工具都是跨平台纯 Python（仅依赖标准库），开箱即用。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>所有命令行输出与代码注释均为<strong>中英文对照</strong>。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2><a id="%E4%B8%80%E3%80%81%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E5%AE%83why" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>一、为什么需要它 / Why</h2>
<p>开发者在不同网络环境下经常需要在「官方源」与「国内镜像源」之间反复切换：<code>nrm</code> 解决了 npm 的痛点，但 pip、brew、docker、maven、go、cargo、yum、apt…… 每一个都要查一遍文档、改一遍配置文件。本套件把这些操作统一起来，命令完全一致：</p>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-bash">switch-xxx ls            # 列出全部预设源 / list all preset sources
switch-xxx use tsinghua  # 切到清华源 / switch to Tsinghua mirror
switch-xxx test          # 给所有源测速排序 / latency-test &amp; rank all sources
</code></pre>
<h2><a id="%E4%BA%8C%E3%80%81%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E6%B8%85%E5%8D%95%EF%BC%88%E5%85%B120%E4%B8%AA%EF%BC%89-tool-list-20-in-total" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>二、工具清单（共 20 个）/ Tool list (20 in total)</h2>

<h2><a id="%E4%B8%89%E3%80%81%E5%85%A8%E5%B1%80%E9%80%9A%E7%94%A8%E6%8C%87%E4%BB%A4%EF%BC%88%E6%89%80%E6%9C%89switch%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E9%80%9A%E7%94%A8%EF%BC%89-shared-commands" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>三、全局通用指令（所有 <code>switch-*</code> 工具通用）/ Shared commands</h2>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-text">ls                   列出所有预设与自定义源（* 标记当前生效源）
                     list all preset &amp; custom sources (* = current)
current              查看当前正在使用的源 / show current source
use &lt;name&gt;           切换至指定命名源 / switch to a named source
add &lt;name&gt; &lt;url&gt; [home]   手动添加自定义私有源 / add a custom source
del &lt;name&gt;           删除一条自定义源 / delete a custom source
test [name]          批量测速所有源并按延迟排序（或测单个）
                     latency-test all sources (or a single one)
home &lt;name&gt;          在浏览器打开对应镜像源主页 / open a source's homepage
backup               备份当前原有配置文件 / back up the original config
restore [stamp]      从最新（或指定时间戳）备份还原配置
                     restore from latest (or given timestamp) backup
help                 查看帮助 / show help
-v / --version       查看版本 / show version
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p><code>switch-node</code> 命令语义按版本管理映射：<code>ls</code>=列版本、<code>use &lt;ver&gt;</code>=切换、<code>add &lt;ver&gt;</code>=安装、<code>del &lt;ver&gt;</code>=卸载、<code>test</code>=验证每个已装版本可运行。</p>
<p><em>switch-node maps commands to version management: ls=list, use=switch, add=install, del=uninstall, test=verify.</em></p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>保留的预设名</strong>（不可 add/del）/ <strong>Reserved preset names</strong> (cannot be added/deleted)：<code>official</code>、<code>tsinghua</code>、<code>aliyun</code>、<code>ustc</code>，部分系统源另有 <code>163</code>。各工具会按该生态实际可用的镜像补齐（详见各工具 <code>ls</code> 输出）。</p>
<h2><a id="%E5%9B%9B%E3%80%81%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E5%BC%80%E5%A7%8Bquick-start" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>四、快速开始 / Quick start</h2>
<h3><a id="%E6%96%B9%E5%BC%8Fa%EF%BC%9A%E8%BF%9C%E7%A8%8B%E4%B8%80%E9%94%AE%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%EF%BC%88%E6%8E%A8%E8%8D%90%EF%BC%89-option-a-remote-one-line-installer-recommended" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>方式 A：远程一键安装（推荐）/ Option A: Remote one-line installer (recommended)</h3>
<p>无需 <code>git clone</code>，一行命令拉取并安装所有 20 个工具，<strong>自动写入 PATH</strong> 并提示如何让当前 shell 立即生效：</p>
<p><strong>Linux / macOS（bash / zsh）</strong>：</p>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-bash"># 国内推荐（Gitee 源，速度快）/ recommended in China (Gitee)
bash &lt;(curl -fsSL https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher/raw/main/bootstrap.sh)
<h1 id="或管道模式无-tty-or-piped-mode-no-tty">或：管道模式（无 TTY）/ or: piped mode (no TTY)</h1>
<p>curl -fsSL <a href="https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher/raw/main/bootstrap.sh" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher/raw/main/bootstrap.sh</a> | bash</p>
<h1 id="只安装指定工具逗号分隔-install-only-specific-tools">只安装指定工具（逗号分隔）/ install only specific tools</h1>
<p>bash &lt;(curl -fsSL .../bootstrap.sh) --tools=npm,pip,yum</p>
<h1 id="卸载--uninstall">卸载 / uninstall</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-bash">bash &lt;(curl -fsSL .../bootstrap.sh) --uninstall<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<p><strong>Windows（PowerShell）</strong>：</p>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-powershell"># 国内推荐 / recommended in China
iwr -useb https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher/raw/main/bootstrap.ps1 | iex
<h1 id="仅安装指定工具--specific-tools-only">仅安装指定工具 / specific tools only</h1>
<p>&amp; ([scriptblock]::Create((iwr -useb <a href="https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher/raw/main/bootstrap.ps1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher/raw/main/bootstrap.ps1</a>))) --tools=npm,pip</p>
<h1 id="卸载--uninstall-1">卸载 / uninstall</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-powershell">&amp; ([scriptblock]::Create((iwr -useb <a href="https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher/raw/main/bootstrap.ps1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher/raw/main/bootstrap.ps1</a>))) --uninstall<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>远程安装策略 / Strategy</strong>：优先 <code>git clone</code>（可增量更新），失败则下载 tarball / zip。国内环境自动选择 Gitee 源，海外用 GitHub；可设置环境变量 <code>MS_SOURCE=gitee|github|auto</code> 强制选择。</p>
<p><em>Prefers <code>git clone</code> (incremental), falls back to tarball/zip. Auto-picks Gitee in CN, GitHub abroad; override with <code>MS_SOURCE</code>.</em></p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>安装后让当前 shell 立即生效 / Make it effective in current shell</strong>：</p>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-bash">source ~/.zshrc       # zsh
source ~/.bashrc      # bash
source ~/.config/fish/config.fish   # fish
# 或重开一个终端 / or open a new terminal
</code></pre>
<h3><a id="%E6%96%B9%E5%BC%8Fb%EF%BC%9A%E4%BB%8E%E6%BA%90%E7%A0%81%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85-option-b-from-source" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>方式 B：从源码安装 / Option B: From source</h3>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-bash">git clone https://gitee.com/eword/mirror-switcher.git
cd mirror-switcher
<h1 id="一键安装全部-20-个工具--自动-path--install-all--auto-path">一键安装全部 20 个工具 + 自动 PATH / install all + auto PATH</h1>
<p>./install.sh</p>
<h1 id="只装部分工具--install-only-some">只装部分工具 / install only some</h1>
<p>./install.sh --tools=npm,pip,yum</p>
<h1 id="卸载--uninstall-2">卸载 / uninstall</h1>
<p>./install.sh --uninstall</p>
<h1 id="单个工具安装传统方式-single-tool-classic">单个工具安装（传统方式）/ single tool (classic)</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-bash">cd switch-pip &amp;&amp; ./install-link.sh<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h3><a id="%E6%96%B9%E5%BC%8Fc%EF%BC%9A%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E7%94%A8-python%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C-option-c-run-with-python-directly" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>方式 C：直接用 Python 运行 / Option C: Run with Python directly</h3>
<p>不想注册全局命令也行 / No global install needed：</p>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-bash">python3 switch-pip/switch-pip.py ls
python3 switch-brew/switch-brew.py use tsinghua
python3 switch-npm/switch-npm.py test
python3 main.py                            # 交互式菜单 / interactive menu
python3 main.py switch-go use goproxy.cn   # 直接调度 / dispatch directly
</code></pre>
<h3><a id="%E5%85%B8%E5%9E%8B%E7%94%A8%E6%B3%95%E7%A4%BA%E4%BE%8Bexamples" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>典型用法示例 / Examples</h3>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-bash"># brew 源操作（语法和 nrm 一模一样）/ brew (same syntax as nrm)
switch-brew ls
switch-brew current
switch-brew use tsinghua
switch-brew use official
switch-brew add mybrew https://my.internal/brew
switch-brew test
<h1 id="pip-跨平台源--cross-platform-pip">pip 跨平台源 / cross-platform pip</h1>
<p>switch-pip ls<br>
switch-pip use aliyun<br>
switch-pip backup          # 备份 ~/.config/pip/pip.conf / back up pip.conf<br>
switch-pip restore         # 还原 / restore</p>
<h1 id="多语言--multi-language-ecosystems">多语言 / multi-language ecosystems</h1>
<p>switch-go use goproxy.cn<br>
switch-cargo use rsproxy<br>
switch-maven use aliyun<br>
switch-docker use daocloud</p>
<h1 id="linux-系统源需-root见下方安全说明-linux-system-sources-need-root">Linux 系统源（需 root，见下方安全说明）/ Linux system sources (need root)</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-bash">switch-yum use aliyun<br>
switch-apt use tsinghua<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h2><a id="%E4%BA%94%E3%80%81%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84%E8%AE%BE%E8%AE%A1architecture" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>五、架构设计 / Architecture</h2>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-plain_text">mirror-switcher/
├── main.py                 # 聚合入口：交互菜单 + 直接调度
├── common/                 # 公共库：一套契约，所有工具共享
│   ├── sources.py          # Source 数据类
│   ├── registry.py         # SourceRegistry：ls/current/use/add/del/test/home/backup/restore
│   ├── cli.py              # 命令行解析与分发（1:1 复刻 nrm）
│   ├── config.py           # 用户自定义源持久化（~/.mirror-switcher/）
│   ├── speedtest.py        # 多线程并发测速
│   ├── backup.py           # 配置文件备份 / 还原
│   ├── system.py           # 跨平台系统识别、which
│   ├── runner.py           # 子进程执行、文件读写
│   ├── browser.py          # 打开主页
│   └── logger.py           # 彩色输出 + 双语辅助 bi()
└── switch-*/               # 每个工具一个目录（薄实现：预设 + apply 逻辑）
    ├── switch-*.py
    ├── install-link.sh     # macOS/Linux 一键软链
    └── install-link.ps1    # Windows PowerShell 注册
</code></pre>
<p><strong>设计要点</strong>：把 nrm 的全部交互逻辑（命令解析、测速、备份、自定义源存储、彩色输出）下沉到 <code>common/</code>；每个 <code>switch-xxx</code> 只需声明 <strong>预设源</strong> + <strong>如何读取/写入该工具的真实配置</strong>（<code>get_current</code> / <code>apply_source</code> / <code>config_files</code>）。这让新增一个工具通常只需要一个 ~80–150 行的文件。</p>
<h2><a id="%E5%85%AD%E3%80%81%E6%AF%8F%E4%B8%AA%E5%B7%A5%E5%85%B7%E7%9A%84%E5%86%85%E7%BD%AE%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F%EF%BC%88%E9%80%9F%E6%9F%A5%EF%BC%89built-in-mirrors-cheat-sheet" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>六、每个工具的内置镜像（速查）/ Built-in mirrors (cheat-sheet)</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>镜像地址为编写时的常用值；若上游调整，可用 <code>add</code> 自行覆盖。所有工具均内置 <code>official</code>（一键恢复官方源）。</p>
<p><em>URLs are common values at time of writing; override with <code>add</code> if upstream changes. Every tool ships <code>official</code> to restore the upstream registry in one step.</em></p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>switch-npm</strong>: official / npmmirror(淘宝) / ustc / huawei / tencent</li>
<li><strong>switch-pip</strong>: official(PyPI) / tsinghua / aliyun / ustc / huawei / tencent</li>
<li><strong>switch-conda</strong>: official / tsinghua / ustc / aliyun（重写 <code>~/.condarc</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-docker</strong>: official / daocloud / dockerproxy / ustc / 163 / baidu（Linux 改 <code>/etc/docker/daemon.json</code>，macOS/Windows 改 Docker Desktop <code>settings.json</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-brew</strong>: official / tsinghua / ustc / aliyun（写 <code>HOMEBREW_*</code> 环境变量并由 shell profile 加载）</li>
<li><strong>switch-git</strong>: official / ghproxy / ghfast / kkgithub / gitclone（<code>git config url.&lt;x&gt;.insteadOf</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-yum</strong>: official / aliyun / tsinghua / ustc / 163（按 centos/rocky/almalinux 自动选路径）</li>
<li><strong>switch-apt</strong>: official / tsinghua / aliyun / ustc / 163（自动区分 ubuntu / debian 家族）</li>
<li><strong>switch-pacman</strong>: official / tsinghua / ustc / aliyun / 163（置顶 <code>Server =</code> 行）</li>
<li><strong>switch-dnf</strong>: official / tsinghua / ustc / aliyun / 163</li>
<li><strong>switch-zypper</strong>: official / tsinghua / ustc / aliyun / sjtu</li>
<li><strong>switch-maven</strong>: official / aliyun / huawei / tencent（重写 <code>~/.m2/settings.xml</code> 的 <code>&lt;mirrors&gt;</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-gradle</strong>: official / aliyun / huawei / tencent（写 <code>~/.gradle/init.gradle</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-go</strong>: official / goproxy.cn / aliyun / goproxy.io / tencent（<code>go env -w GOPROXY/GOSUMDB</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-cargo</strong>: official / rsproxy / tsinghua / ustc / sjtug / aliyun（写 <code>~/.cargo/config.toml</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-composer</strong>: official / aliyun / tencent / huawei（<code>composer config -g</code> 或改 <code>~/.composer/config.json</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-nuget</strong>: official / tsinghua / aliyun / huawei（写 <code>NuGet.Config</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-pub</strong>: official / flutter-io.cn / tsinghua / ustc（<code>PUB_HOSTED_URL</code> + <code>FLUTTER_STORAGE_BASE_URL</code>）</li>
<li><strong>switch-helm</strong>: official / bitnami / aliyun / gitlab（管理名为 <code>switch-helm</code> 的 repo）</li>
</ul>
<h2><a id="%E4%B8%83%E3%80%81%E8%B7%A8%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0%E4%B8%8E%E6%9D%83%E9%99%90%E8%AF%B4%E6%98%8Ecross-platform-permissions" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>七、跨平台与权限说明 / Cross-platform &amp; permissions</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>零三方依赖</strong>：仅使用 Python 3.7+ 标准库，Windows / macOS / Linux 均可运行。</li>
<li><strong>Linux 系统源</strong>（yum / apt / pacman / dnf / zypper）与 <strong>Docker daemon.json</strong> 需要 root。工具会先尝试直接写入，遇权限不足时自动写临时文件并通过 <code>sudo cp</code> 应用；失败则打印精确命令由你手动执行。</li>
<li><strong>备份优先</strong>：改动系统级配置前，强烈建议先 <code>switch-xxx backup</code>。备份存放在 <code>~/.mirror-switcher/backups/&lt;tool&gt;/&lt;时间戳&gt;/</code>，可用 <code>switch-xxx restore</code> 还原。</li>
<li><strong>macOS Homebrew / Flutter</strong>：通过在 shell profile 中插入<strong>带标记的 <code>source</code> 行</strong>加载 <code>mirror.sh</code>，多次 <code>use</code> 幂等，不会污染 profile。</li>
</ul>
<h2><a id="%E4%B8%835%E3%80%81%E5%85%A8%E5%B1%80-path%E8%87%AA%E5%8A%A8%E6%B3%A8%E5%85%A5-auto-path-injection" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>七.5、全局 PATH 自动注入 / Auto PATH injection</h2>
<p><code>install.sh</code> / <code>install-link.sh</code> / <code>bootstrap.sh</code>（以及 Windows 的 <code>install-link.ps1</code> / <code>bootstrap.ps1</code>）<strong>会自动</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li>把 <code>~/.local/bin</code>（Linux/macOS）或 <code>%USERPROFILE%\bin</code>（Windows）<strong>幂等写入</strong> rc 文件 / 注册表；</li>
<li>用 <code># &gt;&gt;&gt; mirror-switcher PATH &gt;&gt;&gt;</code> / <code># &lt;&lt;&lt; mirror-switcher PATH &lt;&lt;&lt;</code> 标记块包裹，重复运行<strong>不会污染</strong> rc 文件；</li>
<li>在结束时<strong>打印 <code>source</code> 命令</strong>让当前 shell 立即生效。</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>支持的 rc 文件 / Supported rc files</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>Linux/macOS：<code>.zshrc</code>、<code>.bashrc</code>、<code>.bash_profile</code>、<code>.profile</code>、<code>.kshrc</code>、<code>.tcshrc</code>、<code>.cshrc</code>、<code>.config/fish/config.fish</code></li>
<li>若以 root 运行：额外写入 <code>/etc/profile.d/mirror-switcher.sh</code>（系统级，所有用户生效）</li>
<li>Windows：用户级 PATH 注册表项 + 当前 PowerShell 会话立即生效</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p>想完全清理 PATH 块时，删除 rc 文件中两个标记之间的行即可。</p>
<p><em>To fully clean the PATH block, delete the lines between the two markers in your rc file.</em></p>
</blockquote>
<h2><a id="%E4%B8%836%E3%80%81%E5%9B%BD%E4%BA%A7%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%E7%B3%BB%E7%BB%9F%E9%80%82%E9%85%8D-domestic-os-support" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>七.6、国产操作系统适配 / Domestic-OS support</h2>
<p>本套件已针对国产/中文发行版做了完整识别与适配，<strong>所有 Linux 工具都会先调用 <code>linux_distro_family()</code> 自动归类，并显示检测到的发行版</strong>：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>发行版 / Distro</th>
<th>家族归类 / Family</th>
<th>推荐工具 / Use tool</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>麒麟 Kylin 桌面/服务器</strong>（含银河麒麟、openKylin）</td>
<td><code>debian</code>（桌面）/ <code>rhel</code>（服务器）</td>
<td><code>switch-apt</code>（桌面） / <code>switch-yum</code> / <code>switch-dnf</code>（服务器）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>统信 UOS</strong>（含家庭版、专业版、服务器版）</td>
<td><code>debian</code> / <code>rhel</code></td>
<td><code>switch-apt</code>（桌面） / <code>switch-yum</code>（服务器）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Deepin</strong> 深度</td>
<td><code>debian</code></td>
<td><code>switch-apt</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>openEuler</strong> 开源欧拉</td>
<td><code>rhel</code></td>
<td><code>switch-yum</code> / <code>switch-dnf</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Asianux</strong>（中标麒麟）</td>
<td><code>rhel</code></td>
<td><code>switch-yum</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>CentOS / Rocky / Alma / RHEL / Oracle</td>
<td><code>rhel</code></td>
<td><code>switch-yum</code> / <code>switch-dnf</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Ubuntu / Debian / Mint / Kali / Raspbian</td>
<td><code>debian</code> / <code>ubuntu</code></td>
<td><code>switch-apt</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Fedora</td>
<td><code>fedora</code></td>
<td><code>switch-dnf</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>openSUSE / SLES</td>
<td><code>suse</code></td>
<td><code>switch-zypper</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Arch / Manjaro / SteamOS</td>
<td><code>arch</code></td>
<td><code>switch-pacman</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Alpine</td>
<td><code>alpine</code></td>
<td>（自行用 <code>add</code> 添加源）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>识别机制 / Detection</strong>：读取 <code>/etc/os-release</code> 的 <code>ID</code> 与 <code>ID_LIKE</code> 字段；显式主 ID 优先，避免被过于宽泛的 <code>ID_LIKE</code> 误判（如某些 Fedora 镜像错误地写了 <code>ID_LIKE=debian</code>）。</p>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-bash"># 在麒麟桌面 V10 上 / on Kylin V10 Desktop:
$ switch-apt use tsinghua
检测到系统 / detected: Kylin V10 SP1
完成后请执行：sudo apt update / after switching run: sudo apt update
<h1 id="在-openeuler-2203-上--on-openeuler-2203">在 openEuler 22.03 上 / on openEuler 22.03:</h1>
</code><p><code class="language-bash">$ switch-yum use aliyun<br>
检测到系统 / detected: openEuler 22.03 LTS<br>
完成后请执行：sudo yum makecache / after switching run: sudo yum makecache<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h2><a id="%E5%85%AB%E3%80%81%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E5%AD%98%E6%94%BE%E4%BD%8D%E7%BD%AEuser-data-location" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>八、用户数据存放位置 / User data location</h2>
<ul>
<li>自定义源、备份：<code>~/.mirror-switcher/</code>（<code>custom/</code>、<code>backups/</code>、<code>brew/mirror.sh</code>、<code>pub/mirror.sh</code>）</li>
<li>该目录在用户主目录下，<strong>不会</strong>写入仓库目录，安全可删。</li>
</ul>
<h2><a id="%E4%B9%9D%E3%80%81%E6%8E%A8%E9%80%81%E5%88%B0gitee-push-to-gitee" class="anchor" aria-hidden="true"><span class="octicon octicon-link"></span></a>九、推送到 Gitee / Push to Gitee</h2>
<pre class="line-numbers"><code class="language-bash">git add .
git commit -m "init: 项目初始化，遵循 switch- 前缀命名，完全对齐 nrm 命令格式"
git push origin main
</code></pre>
